def render(parts):
    bodies = []
    for part in parts:
        bodies.append(encode_part(part))
    estimate = sum(len(body) for body in bodies) + 256
    buffer = bytearray(estimate)
    offset = 0
    for body in bodies:
        buffer[offset : offset + len(body)] = body
        offset += len(body)
    return bytes(buffer[:offset])
